proxy.how: Command hooks: PreToolUse shows the text written before each tool call (from the transcript, in a detached process), Stop shows the reply. What the user writes goes in as a user message before the next model call (PreInvocation), so mid-turn or with the next prompt; nothing wakes an idle session.

docs.summary: Install pixling-proxy in the Antigravity CLI: what the agent writes shows on the resident as it goes, and what you write reaches the agent at its next step.
